facts.text: I am planning a charity event in a few months.
I need help with scheduling for my charity event.
I find it helpful to remember that January comes before February in the calendar.
I am not sure if I want to have the event in Quarter 2.
I want charity event ideas that take place in Quarter 1, specifically in January or February.
I am open to trying something new and unique for the charity event.
I like the idea of a charity run or walk in January.
I want to make the charity run or walk more engaging and attract more participants.
I will start with the themed run/walk and a costume contest.
I will offer a prize for the best group costume.
I will offer a prize for the most creative fundraising idea.
